outliers.issue: Generic audience/meaning/community tasks feature professional interpreting without a cross-language work preference
outliers.evidence: 019 features interpreting alone from 3 questions while writing has 8 and remains a lead. Its reasons are wording, story/language/point of view, and accuracy. 039 has 4 shared questions and multilingual label users, not translation practice. 065 has 8 shared narrative/culture questions but no cross-language activity in an English-speaking biography. These are separate from language proficiency or ability to learn; background language exposure is insufficient to infer preference.
outliers.novelty: Known translation-specificity concern from development; 019 is a sharper observed manifestation of high profile alignment plus thin generic support becoming the sole featured role. It is not a new verified arithmetic bug.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: For a future independently evaluated candidate, distinguish translating/interpreting between languages from writing, audience adaptation and culture/information access through neutral task questions and explicit evidence labels. Keep as a comparison/question when domain preference is unasked. Do not revise the locked candidate or these responses based on the holdout, infer a prerequisite from culture, or gate by current fluency/aptitude.

outliers.issue: Mixed words/images/sound/scene options do not independently establish a professional production medium
outliers.evidence: 022 documents audio editing, announcements and stream recording but features animation alone; film/writing each have 8 task questions and are leads, animation has 7 with profile alignment. 004/060/072 have actual narrative or media practice but no exclusive medium established; 046 remains appropriately open. Actual multi-take video work in 001/028 and a media interview piece in 093 are stronger grounds for film exploration and were not treated as errors.
outliers.novelty: Known multimodal creative-task limitation, not a novel failure type. An adjacent media profession is permissible exploration; sole-medium prominence is less justified than the generic task evidence suggests.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: In a future candidate, describe common storytelling evidence separately from medium-specific evidence, retain named comparisons, and ask preference for writing, static design, photography, audio, performance, animation or editing. Validate with fresh independently held cases; do not suppress low-correlation task interests or force three roles from this holdout.

outliers.severity: P2 known engineering-domain ambiguity persists; earlier inversion limited
outliers.issue: Biomedical remains a featured application without biomedical evidence
outliers.evidence: The biography concerns lighting, simple circuits, fan parts and demonstrations. Frozen answers bundle machine, circuit, or medical device and generic user needs. All three engineering rows have eight questions and comparisonOnly=false. Thus mechanical/electrical remain available, unlike the development superset inversion, but the medical application has no separate endorsed evidence.
outliers.novelty: Known medical-device-union ambiguity. The narrowed subset filter appears to prevent the previously observed sole-biomedical inversion in this case; that is a limited observation, not proof of full specificity or a measured improvement rate.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: For future research, separate general device engineering from application domains through neutral biomedical/biological-use tasks. Keep application possibilities explicitly exploratory when the domain was not asked. Preserve this locked observation without further candidate tuning.

outliers.issue: Enjoyment of familiar making/care does not settle preference for commercial service, production or supervisory work
outliers.evidence: 059 repeatedly bakes but all food/counter/chef roles borrow broad meal/service options; no busy-counter or staff-supervision preference is established. 095 prefers compost experiments and 097 greenhouse comparisons, while crop/landscape roles introduce commercial, seasonal and equipment routines. These are legitimate related occupations, not ground-truth errors.
outliers.novelty: Known shared-task responsibility and routine issue; no new clinical/training equivalence or wage guarantee observed. Open food cases 010/047/049 are valid restraint rather than missed required careers.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: Use supervised trials and questions about daily pace, customers, commercial repetition, seasons, safety and responsibility in future user counseling. Explain experience needed for supervisory roles and keep research/study and practical production routes distinct. Do not rewrite answers or blacklist occupations because a synthetic biography lacks prior paid experience.

outliers.evidence: 003 has about $224/month left, 079 $524, 092 $358 and 099 $1214 in compact plans. Architecture details name professional education, AXP and exams; industrial-design and food-science details name typical degree/portfolio/lab preparation. The excerpt does not include full costs, debt, funding notes, tax/work-hour assumptions or upfront housing costs. Non-Austin and nonresident cases also require local scenarios.
outliers.novelty: No novel training-pay confusion, law-type duration calculation or RN-type zero-cost defect established from the authorized holdout fields. It would be unsupported to certify full funding or financial-source accuracy from these compact summaries.
outliers.proposedGeneralFix: Retain the already corrected adjacent funding conditions and qualified-versus-training interpretation. Future personalized planning should compare actual programs, funding, location, hours, benefits and access costs. Do not fabricate debt/aid, alter the locked engine, or convert a small surplus into an affordability promise.

limits: No uniquely correct career is assumed. Several related choices, low broad-profile correlation with specific tasks, or no featured career can all be defensible. No force-three expectation, target tuning or psychometric accuracy percentage was used.

All biographies and frozen inferred responses are unchanged. The review does not treat synthetic inferred answers as student testimony; low-confidence inference flags and available sensitivity notes limit every precise-looking conclusion.

All30 authorized holdout cases were read only after the parent stated the candidate was locked and the one holdout run completed. No supplemental24 biographies, answers or outcomes were inspected for this review.

Candidate-lock provenance was checked by all15 source hashes matching. Its timestamp is a recorded claim of lock timing; independent verification of run count, unseen accesses or all biography/answer hashes was outside this artifact.

Open cases retain leads or supported full-field rows: e.g. 049 has five food roles with eight-question support; 074/091 have four eight-question teaching/childcare roles. Avoid inventing a winner or interpreting a bounded top-card policy as no interest or ability.

Current compact plans all use qualified-entry examples; the holdout does not exercise residency/apprenticeship transitions, RN/EMT or law. Those earlier corrections cannot be fully revalidated from these fields. Source prices, taxes, wages, costs/debt and court/licensing facts were not independently recertified.

Shared-task card wording and the narrowed subset rule provide limited uncertainty controls; they do not make repeated multimodal prompts independent evidence or supply missing occupational application preferences.

Health, neurodivergence, disability, identity, family loss, financial resources and caregiving were treated as context for access and routine, not predictors of aptitude, a prescribed helping vocation, an automatic profession or an ambition ceiling.

No new verified engine bug or financial arithmetic defect emerged from these compact holdout outputs. Persistent specificity limitations are substantive observations, not evidence of predictive success or failure rates. Any future remedy requires a separately declared candidate and fresh evaluation rather than reuse of this holdout for tuning.
